title: Union bound for a sequence of programs
statement: Let a target Boolean function, a bad predicate on outputs, and a nonnegative extended real number $\delta$ be given. For every finite list of learning programs with the same output type, if each program's outer probability of producing a bad output is at most $\delta$, then the outer probability that the sequence of programs produces a list containing at least one bad output is at most the list length times $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of learning programs with a common output type
Each program in the list has bad-output outer probability at most $\delta$
